population: all 1801 parent rows without both certificates: 1798 torsion_only and 3 quotient_only, preserving all 9688 parent row identities and statuses
exploratory_basis: The first torsion-only row in each of the 16 parent files received a quotient certificate at a prime between 101 and 331 in an exploratory scout; no scout result is used as a final measurement.
extended_prime_law: all primes p with 101 <= p < 500 in increasing order
torsion_only_test: For every torsion_only row, retain the inherited odd-order certificate and test the first good integral prime in the extended law for which P, Q, P+Q all lie outside 2E(F_p); preserve every attempted-prime status and no-hit rows.
quotient_only_test: For every quotient_only row, retain its inherited quotient certificate and enumerate rational roots of the exact 2-division polynomial of its general Weierstrass curve; no roots certifies absence of rational 2-torsion, while roots leave the row uncertified by this theorem.
promotion_gate: A row is certified independent only when it has both a quotient certificate and a no-rational-2-torsion certificate. Preserve all unclassified rows; never infer dependence from no hit.
measurement: exact arithmetic coverage diagnostic on the local host; no wall-time performance comparison
